I4.evidence: The selected initial_full/config.json matches the supplied configuration. In initial_full/model.py, _run implements the manuscript's reduced Newton step with R=Z^T[Q-diag(alpha*sin(y))]Z; solve_adjoint computes -Z L^{-T}L^{-1}Z^T v using retained triangular factors. projection_directional_derivative constructs Mv=0 and normalized-normal orthogonality, imposes one-sided bounds at tight coordinates, and solves the critical-cone projection with Q=I, q=-direction, zero initialization, and 4d+20 iterations. Disabling critical-cone treatment instead fixes all tight coordinates and returns V(V^T direction). These details match manuscript Algorithms 1–2 and Theorems 3–4, including tolerances, local geometry caching, iteration-limit caveats, and the conditional interpretation of reverse-mode generalized-Jacobian membership. The cone helper caches geometry locally rather than reusing forward Cholesky factors; the manuscript describes this accurately. Source inspection establishes formula alignment, not independent reproduction of reported experimental scores.
